THE APPROPRIATION (No. 3) BILL, 2008
(AS PASSED BY THE HOUSES OF PARLIAMENT)
A
BILL
to authorise payment and appropriation of certain further sums from and out of the
Consolidated Fund of India for the services of the financial year 2008-09.
BE it enacted by Parliament in the Fifty- ninth Year of the Republic of India as follows:—
1. This Act may be called the Appropriation ( No. 3) Act, 2008.
2.  From and out of the Consolidated Fund of India there may be paid and applied sums
not exceeding those specified in column 3 of the Schedule amounting in the  aggregate  to
the sum of two lakh thirty-seven thousand two hundred eighty-five crore  and eighty-four
lakh rupees only towards  defraying the several charges which will come in course of pay-
ment during the financial year 2008-09 in respect of the services  specified in column 2 of the
Schedule.
3.   The sums authorised to be paid and applied from and out of the Consolidated Fund
of India by this Act shall be appropriated for the services and purposes expressed in the
Schedule in relation to the said year.
